integrity: A self-contained calculus proof establishes all parameter regimes and the fold. Standalone standard-library code tests the identity and witness. The listed first public date belongs to the original 1954 Ricker stock-recruitment article, as reported in a bibliographic record; the new theorem is not attributed to that article.
scientific_limitations: Short, deterministic two-recruitment-season comparison of a single proportional harvest. No claims for multiple interventions, stochastic fisheries, or terminal catch yield. General timing theorems and unreadable historical full texts may imply the specialized result.
title: A sharp two-crossing timing law for one-off harvest in seasonal Ricker recruitment
